notes.title: Nothing can stop us!
notes.notes:
In the last period of time we received a lot of questions whether we quit or not. The answer is NO. We have never quitted and never will!

We just stopped posting information about every single update, because we missed relevant feedbacks, but the game was still monthly updated.

That’s also how we would like to tell you all, that we won’t inform you about every update we made, until the game is ready for beta testing before the release.

We also want to thank those who wrote constructive, logical and quality reviews. Your suggestions were gladly noticed! Nothing you wrote is going to be wasted!

We have message for those who wrote negative reviews on purpose: The game is free AND in EA and honestly nobody forces you to play it in this stage. This access is more for enthusiasts and for those who want to help us with development. If you don’t want to help, it’s O.K., this isn’t anything for you then.

It is important for you to know that we are not earning money from this. It’s just our hobby and we don’t have any investors, we are doing everything in our free time and we work with our own money.

Thank you all and we are looking forward for the final product!

We also have a lot of other fantastic ideas!

Gaming Cats Studio

notes.title: Sorry.. we abandon IMK: Fresh Meat
notes.notes:
...the reason is hateful community who can't read in EA description: "[i]If you are not excited to play this game in its current state, then you should wait to see if the game progresses further in development.[/i]"

The whole Gaming Cats Studio is now disbanden a no further updates will come and we never make more free games in the future.

The game will be closed in two weeks in STEAM, then can't be reached again.

Also thanks to Jim Sterling for ruin our dreams.

Thanks for your time.

Sincerly your ex - Gaming Cats Studio.
